listing_fee.fee_basis: max(ask price, 50% of trusted reference price when reference exists)

repricing.rule: Price changes beyond ±10% charge a fresh listing fee.

reference_price.method: 7-day weighted median of completed arm's-length sales
reference_price.fallback: vendor/reference value until enough real sales exist
reference_price.anti_manipulation: Ignore self-trades, linked-account trades, wash-trade clusters and extreme low-volume outliers.

principle: Taxes discourage spam/flipping and provide a modest Gold sink; they are not the primary inflation control.

price_band.movement_rule: Reference price may move at most ±12% per 24h for normal items and ±20% for low-volume gear.
price_band.new_item_rule: Use seeded designer reference price until at least 20 trusted completed sales exist.
price_band.anti_gold_transfer: Listings outside the legal band are rejected. Suspicious reciprocal/linked-account trades never update the reference price.

bulk_buy.execution: fill cheapest unit-price listings first until requested quantity or buyer max unit price is reached
bulk_buy.atomicity: single player action; internally may create multiple seller fills

provenance.purpose: rapid-resale surcharge, suspicious transfer detection, support/audit
